people_notes.CHAR-JAKE-KALOPER: Jedi are an established peopled order/community in the world; ObiWan coexists with other Jedi. His home society may include Jedi and non-Jedi humans. Do not clone ObiWan's exact face, wardrobe, green energy sword, companion, or personal identity onto background Jedi.
people_notes.CHAR-WILSON-LOOK: Gorilla-bodied people exist; current principal form remains Arsenal Gorilla Warrior.
people_notes.CHAR-JORDAN-HOLLINGSHEAD: Own broad human/berserker kind exists; horned gear does not prove separate biology.

el_nino.rule: Not every storm is El Niño; atmospheric manifestation requires explicit story/world-state resolution.

jedi_order.domain_relationship: Trade Jedi Mountain Base and surrounding upper-valley society may include other Jedi and ordinary humans.
